notes: Most assertions are non-discriminating: the baseline is already competent at core modelling (code lists, audit, history, PostGIS). Differences: new-model 11 vs 10, xsd 10 vs 8, amend 10 vs 10.

Two amend assertions look flawed, not the runs: 'expired in PermitStatus' and 'fileNumber added + reference deprecated' conflict with strict partner validation (D-002); both runs chose defensible non-breaking alternatives. Reword for iteration 2.

Skill's real differentiators: one implementation-neutral source with tool-generated exports (baseline new-model run hand-wrote SQL/JSON with physical types), datatype/code-list modelling (xsd), traceability (sources/decisions files).
Cost: skill uses ~+25k tokens per run on average; wall time lower on average but the baseline mean is skewed by one 807s run.

Skill/tool gaps seen in transcripts: dmtool cannot emit XML attributes (xs:ID) or integer enum codes (agent wrote a patch script); diff flags new constraints as breaking even when they only apply to new data; GiST indexes for spatial access paths are not generated; external GeoJSON $refs can't resolve offline.
